title: feat(plugin-security): a boot upgrade impact report for the non-access classes, raised to the administrator like the access upgrade report
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuUSKmaWjm1sW7kkQuwKewbx)_

Part of #24447

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Claim 6367925751 (`domain:services` seat 1, #6021). This is the services half of the card: the non-access upgrade report (items 2 and 4 of ruling 6259332195). The spec half, retiring `packages/spec/src/kernel/package-upgrade.zod.ts` with its ADR-0087 conversion, belongs to the spec lane. It was asked for in comment 6367978063 and in pointer 6367986096 on #18549, and it has no card yet, so the card stays open for it. The two halves have no ordering between them. The branch is the harness-pinned `claude/project-thread-mfvys8`, the same one #25489 (#25413) landed from. This PR calls the delivery helper that PR added.

## What changed

An upgrade that renames, removes or collides with a name could leave the customer's stored state meaning something else. Nothing said so beyond a scattered log line. At every boot, right after the access upgrade report, the security plugin now reads that state against the registry. It reports what it finds and changes nothing.

- **New `plugin-security/src/upgrade-impact-report.ts`.** One finding list per class.
  - **Switches (flow, action, webhook ledger rows):**
    - a row whose package no longer ships the name;
    - a switched-off row whose package now ships names of that type that no switch covers (a suspected rename that makes the item active again);
    - a switched-off action whose name more than one object declares (the one row switches every one of them off).
  - **Stored rows a package now overrides:**
    - a stored flow whose name a package ships (the packaged flow runs, the stored one never does);
    - a `sys_webhook` row holding a declared webhook's name (the declaration is withheld for the whole deployment).
  - **Overlay orphans:** an active `sys_metadata` row of a view, dashboard, report, translation or email template, bound to an installed code or marketplace package that no longer ships the item. Bundled types are judged per member.
  - **Object extensions:**
    - a field an extension declares that the base layer (the overlay, else the owner) or another extension also declares, where the last declaration wins;
    - a stored object row bound to a package that does not own the object, which the boot refuses to serve;
    - a navigation contribution whose group its app no longer has (read from `getAppNavDiagnostics`).
  - **Settings:** a stored `sys_setting` / `sys_platform_setting` key that its registered namespace no longer declares. The value is never read, and the scan does not select the value column.
- **Not judged, on purpose (named in the module header):**
  - a package-less object row over a packaged object, which is ADR-0005's sanctioned overlay and cannot be told from a stale one;
  - rows bound to an authored, unknown or disabled package;
  - an unregistered settings namespace;
  - a contribution to an app that is missing (the registry does not list those).
- **Who is told.** The findings go through `upgrade-report-delivery.ts` from #25489, under their own topic `system.upgrade_impact` and a `dedupKey` over the sorted finding set.
  - Under `single`: the Default Organization's administrators and the operators.
  - Under a wall: the operator line. When `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_ORGANIZATION` is set, a copy also goes in-app in that organization.
  - Each category logs one `error` with its fix. A clean boot logs one `info` line.
- **Stops.** A store that cannot be read, or settings manifests that cannot be read, stop the report for that boot with one `warn` naming what was unreadable. An unread answer is never taken for "resolves nowhere", and nobody is told.
- **`security-plugin.ts`:** one call in the `kernel:bootstrapped` hook after the access report. It has its own `try`/`catch`, and the `settings` and `messaging` services are looked up by name.
- **Changeset:** `patch` for `@objectstack/plugin-security`.

Not touched: `packages/spec`, the engine lane (objectql, core, metadata-*, platform-objects), service-automation, plugin-webhooks, service-settings, the ADR.

## Tests

- **`upgrade-impact-report.test.ts` (39 cases), every class with a CONTROL.**
  - The engine double's `find` refuses a combinator or an object value.
  - The registry double answers as the real one does. `getArtifactItem` prefers the named package, else any package. `listItems` hides disabled packages. Contributors come back as own, overlay, extend.
  - Covered: the renamed flow under `single` and `isolated`, a disabled package, a tenant-authored flow, a row with no package, a switched-ON orphan, plural type spellings, inactive rows, another package shipping the same name, bundled members, the overlay as base layer, ADR-0005's package-less overlay, missing navigation diagnostics, a layout-only setting specifier, a missing settings service, four unreadable stores and unreadable manifests, absent stores, no registry, a stable `dedupKey`, and no write verb ever asked for.
- **`upgrade-impact-report.wiring.test.ts` (5 cases).** It uses a real `ObjectQL`, `SqlDriver` and `SecurityPlugin`, with a vendor package before and after its upgrade, an add-on with an object extension and a navigation contribution, and real customer rows.
  - `single` upgraded: all 9 categories, and one emit under the topic to the operator and the Default Organization's administrator.
  - `isolated` upgraded: the operator line and no emit.
  - Both postures, CONTROL: the clean line.
  - The logged lines replayed through the core logger: no value is redacted, and the setting key is named.

## Verification

- **Package suite:** plugin-security `pnpm test`: exit 0, 217 files, 4529 passed and 45 skipped. `pnpm typecheck` (tsc, scripts and test-typecheck): exit 0. eslint on the touched files: exit 0.
- **Dispatch gates:** on this head (`7e12df4c01`, after a full `pnpm build`, 76 of 76 tasks), all 69 commands that `dispatch-gates --commands` derived exit 0. `--ran` reconciles 69 of 69, with exit codes recorded. Before #25489 merged, the same commit on a branch that also carried #25489 derived 100 commands, and all 100 exit 0. `check-governed-merges --pr 25512`: not governed.
- **Ablations** (committed source mutated with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` and restored; `git diff HEAD` is empty after each):
  1. The `security-plugin.ts` call skipped: 5 red (every wiring case).
  2. The base layer left out of the collision check: 5 red.
  3. The overlay's own-package check dropped: 1 red.
  4. The undeclared-key test off: 5 red.
  5. The shared-action threshold raised from more than 1 object to more than 99: 4 red.
  6. A store read failure swallowed as an empty store: 4 red (the four stop cases).
- **R5:** production `os serve` of the showcase on a persistent SQLite file, with `OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=op@r4.example` and `OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`.
  - The impact seed writes these rows directly:
    - a switched-off ledger flow `showcase_recalc_estimate_old`;
    - a dashboard overlay `showcase_ops_dashboard_old` bound to `com.example.showcase`;
    - a package-less stored flow `showcase_recalc_task_estimate`;
    - a `sys_webhook` row `showcase_task_changed`;
    - an object row `showcase_task` bound to `app.r5_custom`;
    - a `sys_setting` `company.legacy_tagline`.
  - The CONTROL seed writes the same rows under names that are still shipped or not taken.
  - The showcase ships no add-on extension, nav contribution or second-object action, so those three categories are pinned by the wiring test only.

  | boot | single | isolated |
  |:--|:--|:--|
  | clean | the clean `info` line | same |
  | impact | 6 category `error` lines, one `sys_notification` (`system.upgrade_impact`) in the Default Organization | setting unset: the 6 lines, then the operator line ("this log is where they are raised"), with no notification. Setting `r4-platform-ops`: the 6 lines, then the operator line with "A copy is raised in-app …" and `organizationId: org_r4_platform`, one `sys_notification` in `org_r4_platform`, and one `sys_inbox_message` for `usr_r4_operator` |
  | impact again | `[messaging] emit: dedupKey … already emitted; skipping` | same, still one row |
  | CONTROL | the clean line, no new notification | same |

  The R5 isolated boot caught one defect, fixed here before this PR opened. The setting finding first carried the key as `key`. The core logger redacts any field of that name, so the line read `"key":"***REDACTED***"`. The field is now `name`, and the fifth wiring case pins it through the real logger. The rig's only other `ERROR` under `isolated` is `[auth] no_sign_in_account_at_boot`. The rig caused it by inserting `sys_user` directly, and it appears on the CONTROL boot too.
